items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-13
items.q: I like Lewis Nelson very much.

ctx.x: Who are your favourites, by the way?

Favourite musicians are Manuel Paul, for one, I don't know what you're just talking about. Captain Handy. George. Lewis. Jim. I like Lewis Nelson very much. I like Jim better. Dee Dee knocked me right out the night I heard Dee Dee. I've only heard him once, but that was tremendous. And Billy, of course, was good. She didn't play on the night, but she sang. And they did a couple of duets, which were really tremendous. I like Kid Thomas. I like Chester's artist very much. And Dre, I've only heard a couple of times,…

items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: George, of course, Lewis Nelson, Chester Zardes, one of the most of all, possibly because I didn't expect to see him and because he just plays excellent bass.

ctx.x: Who are some of the musicians who've really impressed you there? The musicians that really impressed me are Jim, especially Jim.

George, of course, Lewis Nelson, Chester Zardes, one of the most of all, possibly because I didn't expect to see him and because he just plays excellent bass. Soi, Sammy Penn, Manuel Paul very, very much. I think Manuel Paul is one of the best players I've heard here. Thomas. Kid Thomas. Kid Thomas. I like Frank Miliere. I quite like Sweet Emma's playing. Joe Butler is a good singer and quite a good bass player. I wouldn't say he's excellent. I like drag, the night drag played. Alec Bigard, he has impressed me at…
No, in New Orleans. Oh, wait a minute.
